name: Email Poll
description: Poll email accounts for new and updated messages (gog/Gmail and IMAP), classify, and enqueue for download.
prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes) or IMAP credentials

name: Email Download
description: Dequeue threads from email-pending and download full message bodies from Gmail.
prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes)

name: Email Drain Updates
description: Drain the email-updates queue and apply label changes (add, remove, archive, trash) via Gmail API.
prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes)

name: Email Historical Backfill
description: Paced Gmail backfill: each run searches one window (emailConfig.backfill.windowDays) per account, walking back until emailConfig.backfill.lookbackDays, then no-ops. Cursor in runner state (email-backfill/cursor-<email>).
prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes) + emailConfig.backfill (accounts, lookbackDays, windowDays) in pipeline-config.json
